Publication-quality dimensionality reduction plot

Source: R/reduction_plots.R
DimPlot_bioToolkit.Rd

Plots cells on a 2D reduction (UMAP, tSNE, PCA, ...) coloured by a grouping variable, optionally split into one panel per level of a second variable. Every panel (the scatter itself) has a fixed absolute size set by `panel.width` and `panel.height`, so panels are identical across figures regardless of how many there are and of the legend's size or position. Split plots share a single legend covering all groups, even when a panel contains only some of them. Use save_plot to save it: the output file is sized to fit the panels, strips, legend and margins exactly. Text sizes follow theme_bioToolkit.

Usage

DimPlot_bioToolkit(
  object,
  group.by = NULL,
  split.by = NULL,
  reduction = "umap",
  dims = c(1, 2),
  cells = NULL,
  cells.highlight = NULL,
  full.extent = FALSE,
  cols = NULL,
  na.value = "grey88",
  pt.size = 0.3,
  alpha = 1,
  shuffle = TRUE,
  outline = FALSE,
  outline.color = "black",
  outline.size = 0.6,
  outline.darken = 0.4,
  label = FALSE,
  label.size = 3.5,
  mark = FALSE,
  mark.by = NULL,
  mark.cols = NULL,
  mark.linetype = "dashed",
  mark.linewidth = 0.5,
  mark.expand = 0.04,
  mark.smooth = 0.05,
  mark.coverage = 0.98,
  legend.position = c("right", "left", "top", "bottom", "inside", "none"),
  legend.ncol = NULL,
  legend.pt.size = 3.5,
  legend.text.size = NULL,
  ncol = NULL,
  by.row = TRUE,
  arrow.panels = c("bottom.left", "all", "left", "right", "top", "bottom", "none"),
  panel.width = 4,
  panel.height = panel.width,
  panel.spacing = 0.1,
  strip.text.size = NULL,
  strip.text.face = "bold",
  raster = NULL,
  raster.threshold = 10000,
  raster.dpi = 1000,
  bg = "transparent",
  seed = 42,
  ...
)

Arguments

object

A Seurat object

group.by

Metadata column to colour cells by. If NULL, the active identities are used

split.by

Metadata column to split the plot by, one panel per level. If NULL (default), a single panel is drawn. Levels with no cells are dropped

reduction

Name of the reduction to plot, default is "umap"

dims

The two dimensions of the reduction to plot, default is 1 and 2

cells

Cells to plot, as names or indices (e.g. from Seurat::WhichCells()). Other cells are left out of the plot entirely. If NULL (default), all cells are plotted

cells.highlight

Cells to colour, as names or indices. Other plotted cells are drawn in `na.value` and left out of the legend. If NULL (default), all plotted cells are coloured

full.extent

Whether the axes span all cells of the object rather than only the plotted ones, so that a plot of a subset of cells lines up with a plot of the whole object. Default is FALSE

cols

Colours for the groups. If NULL (default), "scanpy-20" (or "scanpy-102" above 20 groups). Otherwise a palette name (see show_palettes), colours named by group (e.g. picked with bt_palette("scanpy-20")[c(1, 3, 2)] and named by cell type), or colours in the order of the group levels. Every level of `group.by` gets a colour, including levels with no plotted cell, so that a plot of a subset of cells uses the same colours as a plot of all

na.value

Colour of cells with no group and of cells not in `cells.highlight`, default is "grey88"

pt.size

Point size, default is 0.3

alpha

Point transparency, default is 1

shuffle

Whether to plot cells in random order so that no group is systematically drawn on top, default is TRUE

outline

Whether to draw an outline around the cell clouds, default is FALSE

outline.color

Colour of the outline: "black" (default), "darken" for a darkened version of each group's colour, or any colour

outline.size

Thickness of the outline (in point size units), default is 0.6

outline.darken

Amount to darken group colours by when `outline.color = "darken"`, between 0 and 1, default is 0.4

label

Whether to label groups at their median position, default is FALSE. When split, groups are labelled within each panel

label.size

Size of the group labels in mm, default is 3.5

mark

Whether to draw a dashed line around the cell cloud of each group of `mark.by`, kept a fixed distance away from the cells, default is FALSE. Typically, cells are coloured by a fine annotation (`group.by`) and outlined by a broader one (`mark.by`). Stray cells far from the rest of their group are left outside the line, and a group split into separate clouds gets one line around each. Only cells in `cells.highlight` are outlined, and when split, groups are outlined within each panel

mark.by

Metadata column whose groups are outlined. If NULL (default), the groups of `group.by`

mark.cols

Colours of the outlines, as for `cols`. If NULL (default), the colours of `cols` when `mark.by` is the same as `group.by`, and the default colours otherwise

mark.linetype

Line type of the outlines, default is "dashed"

mark.linewidth

Line width of the outlines, default is 0.5

mark.expand

Distance the outlines are pushed out from the edge of the cell clouds, in inches, default is 0.04 (about 1 mm). The smoothed edge itself already lies slightly beyond the outermost cells

mark.smooth

Smoothing of the outlines in inches, default is 0.05. Larger values give rounder outlines that bridge larger gaps between cells

mark.coverage

Fraction of each group's cells, from its densest regions, that the outlines are drawn around, default is 0.98. Lower values leave more of the sparse, stray cells outside the line

legend.position

Position of the legend, one of "right" (default), "left", "top", "bottom", "inside" or "none"

legend.ncol

Number of legend columns. If NULL (default), ggplot2 chooses based on the number of groups and the position

legend.pt.size

Size of the legend keys, default is 3.5

legend.text.size

Font size of the legend text in points. If NULL (default), the theme's base size (11)

ncol

Number of panel columns when `split.by` is given. If NULL (default), all panels are laid out in a single row

by.row

Whether panels fill the grid row by row (default, TRUE) or column by column (FALSE)

arrow.panels

Panels that get the dimension arrows: "bottom.left" (default; the first panel of the bottom row), "all", "left" / "right" (the first / last panel of each row), "top" / "bottom" (the top / lowest panel of each column) or "none"

panel.width

Width of a single panel in inches, default is 4

panel.height

Height of a single panel in inches, default is `panel.width`

panel.spacing

Gap between panels in inches, default is 0.1

strip.text.size

Font size of the panel (split) labels in points. If NULL (default), the theme's large size (12)

strip.text.face

Font face of the panel labels, default is "bold"

raster

Whether to rasterize the points while keeping text, legend and arrows as vectors: NULL (default) rasterizes when there are more than `raster.threshold` cells, or TRUE / FALSE

raster.threshold

Number of cells above which `raster = NULL` rasterizes, default is 10000

raster.dpi

Resolution of the rasterized points, default is 1000. Match the `dpi` used when saving raster (e.g. png) output

bg

Background colour, default is "transparent", so that the figure can be placed on any background (gaps inside outlines and label halos are then white). Use e.g. "white" for an opaque background

seed

Random seed used for shuffling and label placement, default is 42. The global random number generator state is not changed

...

Arguments of the dimension arrows, as in add_dimension_arrows: the arrows scale with the panel size, and `arrow.scale` makes them larger or smaller (e.g. `arrow.scale = 0.8`; default 1, 2 cm arrows on a 3.5-inch panel); the snake_case names used before 0.10.0 are deprecated. `rasterize` is accepted as a deprecated alias of `raster`

Value

a ggplot object
